title: Chapter 10 Upgrading Residential Buildings
content:
Chapter 10 Upgrading Residential Buildings

[Player ID: 9998 Zhao Shanhe, requesting to add you as a friend. 】

"You can also add friends?" Wang Shuo asked in surprise. Since he had not studied these things before, he didn't know about this function yet.

I chose to agree immediately.

Zhao Shanhe: "Brother, what are you planning to replace with your tiles?"

Wang Shuo thought for a moment that he was lacking a lot of things now, and he didn't know what to change for a while.

Wang Shuo: "What are you going to exchange for?"

"How's the water?"

Wang Shuo couldn't even finish the water, so he immediately refused.

"Where's the food? I have some meat."

"I'm not short of food either." Wang Shuo held back, he still wanted to exchange for something better.

Zhao Shanhe immediately understood that the other party should be like him and had no shortage of the most basic survival supplies. It seemed that if he didn't come up with something good, he wouldn't be able to replace the tiles.

"I also have a blueprint for making a water purifier. My territory has mountain spring water and I don't need a water purifier. Would you like to replace it?" Zhao Shanhe was a little unsure. Although this is a good thing, if others don't need it, then he won't need it. It’s valuable.

Wang Shuo thought for a while. He could drink the water after boiling it, but it would be troublesome. He immediately replied: "Okay, but I don't really need this. Do you have anything else? For example, salt, iron, etc."

Zhao Shanhe's heart sank, he thought for a moment, and said, "I also have a blueprint for making the 'Golden Armor Warrior Puppet'."

"Puppet making drawings, high-end goods!" Wang Shuo became interested, with a smile on his face.

But he said calmly: "Isn't it difficult to make such high-end goods?"

Zhao Shanhe immediately sent the drawing information.

[Golden Armor Warrior: 500 iron ingots + 100 gold ingots + 1 soul crystal]

(One-time consumption of blueprints, 1 energy provides power for a day, and combat consumes 1 energy per minute.)

"Let me go, these are all materials I have never seen before. There are also souls and energy that I have never heard of." Wang Shuo was shocked.

"This puppet making drawing is a good thing, but I don't know when it will be made. And it can only be made one, and it cannot be made in batches, so the value has been reduced a lot. I can give you 150 tiles at most. And that water purifier drawing , if you want to change, just 50 tiles, forget it if you don’t change.”

Zhao Shanhe also thought this way. God knows when it will be produced. In this rapidly changing place, improving the current strength is the most important thing, so there was no further bargaining and the two parties reached a deal.

In fact, he also has a blueprint for making a "steel puppet", which is much less difficult, and he plans to make it himself.

But this seemingly tall puppet is currently useless and might as well be used in exchange for resources.

[Tile -200, golden armor warrior puppet production drawing +1, water purifier production drawing +1]

Wang Shuo currently has none of the materials needed to make the puppet, and is obviously unable to use them.

As for the water purifier drawings, neither of them really needed them, so they settled the deal at a very low price.

Immediately afterwards, Wang Shuo sent another message in the [Chat Channel].

Wang Shuo: "The tiles are exchanged for resources, with a price secret, and a blueprint for making a water purifier. If you are quick, you can get it, but if you are slow, you can't."

Then proceed to making adobe bricks and tiles.

Within a few seconds, Duan Wenxi, a player with ID: 2222, requested to add Wang Shuo as a friend.

"Boss, that's awesome! High-end products like tiles are available so quickly."

Wang Shuo felt a little embarrassed when he was flattered.

"I would like to replace your water purifier production drawings."

Wang Shuo was stunned for a moment, this brother's thinking was a bit out of the ordinary!

"Boss, how about I trade it with you for water?"

Wang Shuo gave him an eye-roll expression: "You don't even want the blueprints for my water purifier, do you think I will be short of water?"

Duan Wenxi muttered in his heart: "That's not a quota. What if you feel it's useless because you're short of water, or you can't make it yourself?"

Then he said: "Haha, just kidding!"

Duan Wenxi was a little depressed. His territory was located in the center of the river and was surrounded by water, but it was polluted water.

He was so angry. Fortunately, there were fish in the river, and he could still eat them if he caught them. He didn't know why.

By exchanging supplies with others, he finally got through the first night without any danger, but he didn't accumulate any resources. Looking at the river flowing in front of him, he felt uncomfortable being in a treasure mountain without access to it.

Seeing Wang Shuo's water purifier production drawings, he knew that his opportunity had come and he could never give up.

After all, clean water is also an important resource.

"I also have an exquisite bamboo bow here, and I'll give you 100 more arrows."

Wang Shuo looked at the illustrated guide sent by the other party. The attack power was only +5. Wang Shuo was a little disgusted, but it was better than nothing. He asked again: "Is there anything else? I don't really need these!"

Duan Wenxi was a little embarrassed. He looked at the bronze treasure box in his backpack, with a look of reluctance on his face, and sighed: "It's a pity that a bronze key is needed to open it."

He didn't know if he could live long enough to open the treasure chest, so he might as well exchange it for the resources in front of him.

"Boss, I have something good here." He sent the illustration of the bronze treasure chest to Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo was surprised when he saw it, and immediately asked in confusion: "You are actually willing to exchange for such a good thing?"

He guessed: "Either the other party is crazy, or they are at the end of their rope. If they are at the end of their rope, they should exchange food!"

Duan Wenxi explained: "Ten birds in the forest are not as good as one bird in the hand. Now we are facing the test of life and death at any time. It is better to exchange these future resources for the current resources and improve our strength as soon as possible."

Wang Shuo felt that it made sense for a while. This kid is a wise man!

"How do you want to exchange?" Wang Shuo asked. The value of a bronze treasure chest should be higher than the value of a water purifier production blueprint.

"A water purifier blueprint plus 100 tiles."

Seeing this proposal, Wang Shuo was silent for a while, touched his chin and said: "Okay, but the bamboo bow will be a bonus, what do you think?"

Bronze treasure chest!

Not knowing what good things will come out, Duan Wenxi gritted his teeth and agreed to the transaction.

After all, he has not yet found anyone willing to exchange resources with others using water purifier blueprints.

The two reached an agreement and clicked on the transaction.

[Bronze treasure chest +1, bamboo bow +1, arrow +100, water purifier blueprint -1, tile -100]

Wang Shuo doesn't have a bronze key now, so he has to put the treasure chest in the warehouse and open it when he has the key.

Considering that tiles are currently a best-seller, he made a lot more.

After sorting out the warehouse, his current resources are:

[Wood × 40; Stone × 40; Hemp rope × 120; Tile × 2000; Earth brick × 400; Water tank × 3; Pottery jar × 10; Earth pot × 1; Bowl × 1; ...]

To upgrade the house, wood and stone are not enough again. He found someone in the chat group who exchanged wood for resources. He exchanged 50 tiles for 100 wood. After all, many players in the forest now have advanced logging tools, and wood, a basic resource, is no longer as tight as before.

Similarly, 50 tiles were exchanged for 50 stones. After all, tiles are a necessity for upgrading stone houses and the demand is booming.

Immediately, he silently said "upgrade residential houses" in his heart.

[Residential houses: wood 140/100, earth bricks 400/400, tiles 1900/400, stone 140/50]

[Are you sure you want to upgrade the brick and tile house to a residential house? ]

"OK."

[Wood -100, earth bricks -400, tiles -400, stone -50]

[Residential houses are under construction, it will take 2 hours]

...

Looking at the time, it was 4 o'clock in the afternoon. There was not much clay left, so he went to the flax field in the north to collect resources again.

An hour later, he got some clay, flax: 1000, flax seeds: 400, fish: 30, and some loaches and eels.

After storing them all in the warehouse, Wang Shuo only had the elite crocodile left to deal with.

When he came to 20 meters south of the shelter, he began to use the "mud pit creation" skill to make traps.

Half an hour later, he had dug a pit 6 meters long, 4 meters wide and 8 meters deep.

Using the skill of "making mud pit" to turn the ground into a swamp, and then using "mixing mud" to collect silt, it was not too easy for him to dig the trap.

He also used some branches and leaves to cover it, and put the piece of smelly rat meat on it as bait.

The trap was made.

After thinking about it, he put 10 more fish on the trap.

He had done what he should do, and the rest was up to fate.
